Une douleur dorsale persistante peut être due à une tension musculaire ou une mauvaise posture. Essayez des étirements doux comme le chat-chameau. Si la douleur persiste, consultez un kinésithérapeute.

I have lower back pain for 2 weeks
Lower back pain lasting 2 weeks may be due to muscle strain. Apply heat therapy and try cat-cow stretches. A physiotherapist can assess and create a personalized recovery plan for you.

I have shoulder pain when lifting my arm

Shoulder pain when lifting could indicate rotator cuff strain or impingement. Try gentle pendulum exercises and avoid overhead movements. A physiotherapist can properly diagnose and treat the underlying cause.

I twisted my ankle playing football
An ankle sprain from sports needs the POLICE protocol: Protection, Optimal Loading, Ice, Compression, Elevation. A sports medicine specialist can assess severity and guide your recovery timeline.
